claim: Patchline ships a verified macro extension suite with hygiene proofs so user extensions cannot break soundness. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the verified macro extension claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make verified-macro-extension-gate`.
